eval.name: replicated-shard-rebalancer
eval.description: Can an agent implement a deterministic replicated-shard rebalancer that preserves hard placement constraints while optimizing balance and movement?

tasks.name: implement-rebalancer
tasks.prompt: Implement ReplicatedShardRebalancer.Rebalance in the provided .NET 10 solution. Read README.md carefully and preserve the public JSON/CLI contract. The engine must return deterministic target placements satisfying capacity, exclusion, replica-count, and maximum-zone-diversity rules while lexicographically minimizing maximum utilization, utilization spread, moved bytes, and moved replica count. You may modify source files in the workspace, but do not add external packages or network dependencies. Run `dotnet run --project visible-tests\ReplicatedShardRebalancer.VisibleTests` until the visible tests pass, and use the supplied validator while developing. When finished, respond with a concise summary of the algorithm and tests run.
